decision: No geometry mutation applied before physical Profiler/Frame Debugger evidence.

candidateDecisions.reason: Environment renderer count is already at the soft budget and there is no physical draw-pass bottleneck yet.
candidateDecisions.allowedScopeAfterDeviceEvidence: Only non-interactive background strips or decorative clusters.
candidateDecisions.blockedScope: Actors, outposts, build slots, touch targets, pathing roots and VFX sockets.

candidateDecisions.reason: Repeated props and road stones may benefit if Frame Debugger shows repeated material draw calls.
candidateDecisions.allowedScopeAfterDeviceEvidence: Repeated non-interactive prop families sharing one material.
candidateDecisions.blockedScope: Unique actor/building silhouettes where per-role material or socket identity matters.

candidateDecisions.reason: Static terrain, road and boundary dressing are safe candidates only after draw-call evidence.
candidateDecisions.allowedScopeAfterDeviceEvidence: Terrain, road, boundary and keep dressing with no gameplay collider or input role.
candidateDecisions.blockedScope: Build slots, selected outpost panels, dynamic outpost state models, actors and VFX.

candidateDecisions.reason: Current actor/building triangle counts are well below art-bible soft budgets; LOD would add authoring and QA cost without measured benefit.
candidateDecisions.allowedScopeAfterDeviceEvidence: Only large boundary/keep silhouettes if physical triangle or overdraw evidence demands it.
candidateDecisions.blockedScope: Small actors and the six gameplay-critical building silhouettes.

regressionGuards: No generated FBX, prefab, catalog, slot, route or camera file changed for this checkpoint.
Picking, pathing, eight build slots and touch targets remain untouched.
Any future geometry optimization must include before/after draw call, triangle and interaction regression evidence.
completionGate: VIS-805 may move from Bekliyor to In review. It cannot be Tamamlandi until physical Profiler/Frame Debugger evidence proves whether a candidate should be applied or rejected.
